name: workflow
description: Planning and workflow skills: natural planning, repo status updates, release PRs for R and Python packages, open-source contribution scouting, pypet command-snippet curation, and taking a greenfield PoC to production through a spec and TDD loop. Includes two tool-restricted subagents: browser-worker for browser audits and test-first fixes that end in a pull request, and the read-only analyst for status sweeps and analyses across GitHub repositories and scheduled tasks.
